'''Lesher''' was an [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Fifty-third Armored Platoon]], an armored unit in the [[Republic Army]], during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. In [[3640 BBY]], he led his platoon, along with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Marshall]]'s [[Eighty-first Infantry]], and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Coria]] of the [[Safecrackers]], in aiding [[Havoc Squad]]'s assault on the [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]] to capture [[General/Legends|General]] [[Arkos Rakton]], one of the Empire's greatest strategists and military leaders.<ref name="TOR" />
